title: Machine Learning Engineer Advanced Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to deepen expertise, build a senior‑level portfolio, and prepare for leadership roles and interviews. Focuses on advanced ML concepts, MLOps, and polished project delivery.

phases.title: Foundations Refresh
phases.summary: Strengthen core mathematical and programming fundamentals essential for ML work.

milestones.title: Python mastery for ML
milestones.outcome: Write clean, efficient Python code for data pipelines and model training.

tasks.title: Complete Python functions refresher
tasks.description: Work through the freeCodeCamp Python Functions module, writing each exercise solution.

tasks.title: Implement a data loader script
tasks.description: Write a script that reads CSV files, handles missing values, and outputs a cleaned DataFrame using pandas.

tasks.title: Practice list comprehensions
tasks.description: Solve 10 list‑comprehension challenges from Real Python to improve concise coding.

tasks.title: Reflect on code style
tasks.description: Review your script against PEP8 guidelines and note three improvements.

milestones.title: Math fundamentals for ML
milestones.outcome: Apply linear algebra and probability concepts to model design and analysis.

tasks.title: Watch Khan Academy linear algebra series
tasks.description: Watch videos covering vectors, matrices, and eigenvalues; take brief notes after each.

tasks.title: Solve matrix multiplication exercises
tasks.description: Complete 10 matrix multiplication problems on MIT OpenCourseWare worksheets.

tasks.title: Implement probability functions
tasks.description: Code functions for PDF, CDF, and sampling of normal and binomial distributions using NumPy.

tasks.title: Connect with a math peer
tasks.description: Join a Reddit r/learnmath thread and discuss a tricky concept you encountered.

phases.title: Core Skills Deep Dive
phases.summary: Gain expertise in key ML libraries, evaluation techniques, and production basics.

milestones.title: Advanced scikit-learn pipelines
milestones.outcome: Create robust preprocessing and modeling pipelines for tabular data.

tasks.title: Read scikit-learn pipeline docs
tasks.description: Study the official scikit-learn Pipeline and ColumnTransformer documentation on scikit-learn.org.

tasks.title: Build a preprocessing pipeline
tasks.description: Implement a pipeline that handles scaling, encoding, and imputation for a Kaggle dataset.

tasks.title: Practice cross‑validation
tasks.description: Run 5‑fold cross‑validation on the pipeline and record performance metrics.

tasks.title: Reflect on pipeline errors
tasks.description: Identify two common pipeline pitfalls and write how to avoid them.

milestones.title: PyTorch for production models
milestones.outcome: Develop, train, and export deep learning models using PyTorch.

tasks.title: Watch PyTorch fundamentals tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official PyTorch 60‑minute intro video on pytorch.org and take notes.

tasks.title: Implement a CNN on CIFAR‑10
tasks.description: Code a convolutional neural network, train it for 10 epochs, and achieve >60% accuracy.

tasks.title: Export model with TorchScript
tasks.description: Convert the trained model to TorchScript and save the scripted file.

tasks.title: Connect with PyTorch community
tasks.description: Post a question about model export on the PyTorch Discuss forum and engage with replies.

milestones.title: Model evaluation and monitoring
milestones.outcome: Select appropriate metrics, perform error analysis, and set up basic monitoring.

tasks.title: Read model evaluation guide
tasks.description: Study the Model Evaluation section of the scikit-learn documentation.

tasks.title: Create a confusion‑matrix dashboard
tasks.description: Use seaborn to plot confusion matrices for binary and multi‑class models.

tasks.title: Practice calibration curves
tasks.description: Generate reliability diagrams for a probabilistic classifier and interpret results.

tasks.title: Reflect on metric trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a short note comparing precision‑recall vs ROC‑AUC for your use case.

phases.title: Proof of Work (Portfolio)
phases.summary: Produce polished, deployable projects that showcase senior‑level competence.

milestones.title: Churn prediction with write‑up
milestones.outcome: A complete end‑to‑end churn model with documentation ready for a portfolio.

tasks.title: Select a churn dataset
tasks.description: Download a public churn dataset from Kaggle and explore its features.

tasks.title: Build a scikit-learn model
tasks.description: Create a pipeline, train a GradientBoosting model, and achieve >80% ROC‑AUC.

tasks.title: Write a technical blog post
tasks.description: Draft a 1500‑word post describing data prep, modeling choices, and results, including code snippets.

tasks.title: Add model versioning
tasks.description: Integrate DVC to track data and model files, committing them to a Git repo.

milestones.title: Image classifier API deployment
milestones.outcome: A containerized image classification service accessible via REST.

tasks.title: Train an image classifier
tasks.description: Fine‑tune a ResNet18 model on a small custom image set using PyTorch.

tasks.title: Write FastAPI wrapper
tasks.description: Create a FastAPI endpoint that loads the model and returns predictions for uploaded images.

tasks.title: Dockerize the service
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile, build the image, and test the container locally.

tasks.title: Document deployment steps
tasks.description: Prepare a README with clear instructions to run the API on any machine.

milestones.title: Monitoring dashboard prototype
milestones.outcome: A live dashboard visualizing model drift and performance metrics.

tasks.title: Set up Prometheus exporter
tasks.description: Instrument the FastAPI service to expose latency and error metrics.

tasks.title: Create Grafana dashboard
tasks.description: Design panels showing request count, error rate, and prediction distribution.

tasks.title: Simulate drift data
tasks.description: Generate synthetic data that gradually shifts distribution and feed it to the model.

tasks.title: Reflect on alert thresholds
tasks.description: Write three criteria for triggering alerts based on metric trends.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Master advanced topics, leadership practices, and senior‑level interview preparation.

milestones.title: MLOps fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Implement CI/CD pipelines and model registry basics for production workflows.

tasks.title: Read MLOps overview article
tasks.description: Study the free MLOps guide on MLflow.org to understand experiment tracking and model registry.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions CI
tasks.description: Create a workflow that runs unit tests and linting on every push for a ML repo.

tasks.title: Register model with MLflow
tasks.description: Log the churn model to an MLflow tracking server and transition it to ‘Production’ stage.

tasks.title: Connect with MLOps community
tasks.description: Join the MLOps Community Slack and share your pipeline for feedback.

milestones.title: Leadership & communication
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate ability to lead projects, mentor peers, and convey technical ideas clearly.

tasks.title: Read effective tech communication guide
tasks.description: Read the free “Communicating Data Science” article on Towards Data Science.

tasks.title: Prepare a project pitch deck
tasks.description: Create a 10‑slide deck summarizing one portfolio project for non‑technical stakeholders.

tasks.title: Mentor a junior on a task
tasks.description: Guide a peer through building a simple preprocessing script, providing feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on leadership style
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph identifying strengths and areas for growth as a technical lead.

milestones.title: Senior interview prep
milestones.outcome: Confidently tackle system design, coding, and ML case interviews at senior level.

tasks.title: Solve senior‑level coding problems
tasks.description: Complete 5 hard algorithm challenges on LeetCode focusing on Python implementations.

tasks.title: Study ML system design patterns
tasks.description: Read the “Designing Machine Learning Systems” free ebook chapter on model serving.

tasks.title: Mock a design interview
tasks.description: Pair with a colleague to role‑play a system design interview for a recommendation engine.

tasks.title: Review past interview feedback
tasks.description: Analyze previous interview notes and list three actionable improvements.
